input.title: Unisex Bat – Sleeps All Day. Judges All Night. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

SLEEPS ALL DAY. JUDGES ALL NIGHT. is the bat hoodie for the night owl who is awake at 2 a.m. and unimpressed by it, worn on the couch, on the late shift and as a gift for the friend who texts after midnight.

SLEEPS ALL DAY. runs across the top in tall condensed capitals and JUDGES ALL NIGHT. stacks in two huge lines below. Between them a small fruit bat hangs upside down from a twig, wrapped in its wings like a blanket, one eye half open and deeply unimpressed, with a crescent moon and three stars beside it.

Navy carries cream and dusty lilac lettering with a cream edge around the bat; Sand gets deep plum and dark slate lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this bat hoodie warm enough for late nights and cool couches?
Yes. The Sleeps All Day. Judges All Night. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for late nights, the couch and cool rooms.

How does the Sleeps All Day. Judges All Night. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a night owl?
It is a natural one. Every night owl knows the friend who texts at 2 a.m., so it lands with bat lovers, late-shift workers and anyone who sleeps through the morning. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the bat sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Sleeps All Day. Judges All Night. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
